text:
Olivia (sales): Urgent: SG POC tomorrow. Customer pinned model "redwood-orbit-v1" and calls from ap-sg are returning MODEL_NOT_FOUND then 429s. Need triage, a short dedicated-trial price, and quick security answers. Logs below.

Chen (se): Paste the exact request and the error snippet? Did they pin by name or manifest id?

Olivia (sales): They used literal "model: "redwood-orbit-v1"". Proxy excerpt:
[2026-12-02T23:11:02Z] id=5f1a2 model=redwood-orbit-v1 region=ap-sg status=404 err=MODEL_NOT_FOUND msg="variant not staged"
[2026-12-02T23:11:03Z] id=5f1b3 model=redwood-orbit-v1 region=ap-sg status=429 err=NO_FALLBACK msg="account route has no fallback"

Priyanka (infra): Likely explanation: exact artifact not pushed to AP-SG. Fast options: 1) enable account alias fallback mapping pinned=redwood-orbit-v1 -> redwood-orbit-v1-quant / -compat in ap-sg (fast, ~1hr), or 2) provision a small Dedicated pool (2x A100-eq) for 14 days (activation ~24-48h). If they insist on exact artifact we need manifest id for a manifest push.

Mateo (security): Compliance questions flagged: KMS envelope encryption, SOC2 attestation, and regional log residency controls. Hosted gives SOC2 + encrypted-at-rest; for guaranteed log residency use Dedicated or Private. I can send a one-pager.

Chen (se): For immediate unblock ask customer to accept a compatible variant. We can also provide a temporary header example to allow fallback: `x-allow-fallback: 1`. Example call:
POST /v1/generate
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <key>, x-allow-fallback: 1
Body: {"model": "redwood-orbit-v1", "input": "..."}

Infra-bot: Deployment catalog:
- redwood-orbit-v1: manifest M-e7c4 deployed: eu-west, us-east
- redwood-orbit-v1-quant: manifest M-e7c4-q deployed: ap-sg (replicas:3)
- redwood-orbit-v1-compat: manifest M-e7c4-c deployed: ap-sg (replicas:1)

Priyanka (infra): Ballpark infra cost for 2x A100-eq x14d ~ $9k-$12k. Recommend quoting $17k including monitoring + support for the trial. Alias fallback can be applied ~60-90m after written consent.

Olivia (sales): Contact: r.lee@apclient.com. I'll ask if they accept fallback and get written confirmation. Please prep the one-pager and quote.

(45 minutes later)

Olivia (sales): Customer confirmed they will try `redwood-orbit-v1-quant` for the POC if we note quality/latency differences in writing.

Priyanka (infra): Applying alias fallback now.

Infra-bot: Alias rule applied for acct-882: pinned=redwood-orbit-v1 -> redwood-orbit-v1-quant in ap-sg. Quick smoke tests returning 200; monitoring for 429 spikes.

Chen (se): Great. Olivia please send the security one-pager and the trial quote to r.lee, and note that exact artifact parity requires a manifest push (24-48h).

Quote-bot: Draft trial quote: $17,500 for 14-day dedicated trial (2x A100-equivalents) including 24/7 monitoring and a single POC contact. Finalize with Finance if they want changes.

Olivia (sales): Thanks all 1 closing loop with client now.
